correctness.rationale: For x nonzero and H SPD, set s=rho||x||/||Hx||. Exactly f(x-sHx)-f(x)=-rho sqrt(AC)+rho^2 BC/(2A), with A=x^TH^2x, B=x^TH^3x, C=||x||^2. Thus per-state boundary 2 A^(3/2)/(B sqrt C). Normalize spectrum X in [1/kappa,1], and let Y=X^2; convexity of y^(3/2) implies maximal E[X^3] at a two-endpoint mixture for each E[X^2]. Differentiating B/A^(3/2) gives p=a^2(a+2)/((a+1)(a^2+a+1)) and rho*=3sqrt(3) a(a+1)/(a^2+a+1)^(3/2). Independently numerically verified rational p and closed forms for k=1,2,9,100. Endpoint mixture provides exact equality at threshold and objective increase above it. Distinction from uniform strict inequality at zero and boundary is correct.
